# ui-board

The freeform board pages (harness-boards, J in the harness map): the boards of the project, the rendered snapshot of one, its diagram's breadcrumb, the last commit and every object with its words, its role and the precise links it carries.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-board.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-board.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md), [ui-linking](ui-linking.md)
- **Brings along:** [board](board.md) (the rest of it)

## About

The board pages.  `harness-boards` lists the boards of the project,
and RET opens one: the rendered snapshot of the diagram at the top --
the SVG the engine's own renderer draws, from the same geometry the
Flutter client draws -- then the breadcrumb of the diagram walked
into, the last commit, and every object with its exact words, its
role and the links it carries.

Nothing here is a second model of the board.  The page reads
`_harness/board/get`, which answers the document a client draws from,
and shows it: a picture, and the text beside it.  A link an object
carries is opened by the house navigation (`harness-ui-linking`), so a
task, a message, a tool call or a review thread opens where it opens
everywhere else.  Opening the board in Flutter is a real
`_harness/board/focus` request; when no client is connected the page
says so rather than pretending one is.

The pages talk ACP only, so they show the harness the UI is connected
to, on this machine or another, the same way.  They never block: a
request's answer redraws the page when it comes.

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-boards` — Show the boards the harness keeps, and open one.
- `harness-ui-board-focus` — Ask a connected Flutter client to show OBJECT, or BOARD, and say if none is.
- `harness-ui-board-links` — Offer what OBJECT, or BOARD, is linked to: the precise targets it names.
- `harness-ui-board-open` — Open board ID, at DIAGRAM and OBJECT when they are named.
- `harness-ui-board-open-pin` — Show the pinned revision PIN as a page of its own.
- `harness-ui-board-refresh` — Read the board the page shows again, and redraw.
- `harness-ui-board-snapshot` — Show the rendered snapshot of the diagram in a viewer of its own.
- `harness-ui-boards-refresh` — Fetch the boards of the project, or of every project, and redraw.
- `harness-ui-boards-toggle-all` — Show every project's boards, or only the page's project.

### Options

- `harness-ui-board-buffer-name` — Name of the buffer that lists the boards.
- `harness-ui-board-page-name` — Name of the buffer that shows one board; %s is its id.

## Uses

### Methods it calls

- `board/focus` ([board-store](board-store.md))
- `board/get` ([board-store](board-store.md))
- `board/list` ([board-store](board-store.md))
- `board/pins` ([board-store](board-store.md))

### Events it hears over ACP

- `board/changed` → `harness-ui-board--on-event`
- `board/created` → `harness-ui-board--on-event`
- `board/deleted` → `harness-ui-board--on-event`
- `board/focused` → `harness-ui-board--on-event`

### Hooks it adds to

- `harness-ui-connected-hook` → `harness-ui-board--on-connect`
- `harness-ui-event-functions` → `harness-ui-board--on-event`
